arStrings.szText: {c_important}Puncture{/c} now deals {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEA_IMPACT}{/c} damage and every {c_number}{SF_20}rd{/c} {c_important}Puncture{/c} will also ricochet up to {c_number}[SF_35]{/c} times. Hits against Slowed enemies will always ricochet.

{c_important}Puncture{/c} becomes a {c_important}Cutthroat{/c} Skill.

{c_important}Puncture{/c} now throws {c_number}3{/c} blades in a spread, each dealing {c_number}[{SF_21} * 100|%|]{/c} of its Base damage. Hitting an enemy with all {c_number}3{/c} blades at once makes them {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} for {c_number}{SF_18}{/c} seconds.

{c_important}Puncture{/c} now also applies {c_number}[{SF_29} * 100|%|]{/c} of its Base damage as Poisoning damage over {c_number}[SF_28]{/c} seconds and also Poisons up to {c_number}[SF_34]{/c} enemies near your target. Enemies Poisoned this way are always pierced by {c_important}Puncture{/c} and your Critical Strike Chance against them is increased by {c_number}[{SF_44} * 100|%+|]{/c}.
Gain {c_number}{SF_40}{/c} Energy when {c_important}Puncture{/c} damages an enemy and an additional {c_number}{SF_9}{/c} Energy if the enemy is Crowd Controlled.

{c_important}Puncture{/c} Slows enemies by {c_number}[{SF_15}*100|%|]{/c} for {c_number}{buffduration:SLOW}{/c} seconds. Critical Strikes will Immobilize enemies for {c_number}{buffduration:SIDE2_IMMOBILIZE}{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Puncture{/c} pierces through {c_number}{SF_43}{/c} enemy and has its range increased by {c_number}[{SF_39} * 100|%|]{/c}.
